lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har saalaahee sadaa sadaa tan man saup sareer ||
lines.translation: Praise the Lord, forever and ever; dedicate your body and mind to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee sach paaiaa sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the True, Profound and Unfathomable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan hiradai rav rahiaa har heeraa heer ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the jewel of jewels, is permeating my mind, body and heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਫੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh gaiaa phir pavai na pheer ||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death are gone, and I shall never again be consigned to the cycle of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too har gunee gaheer ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the ocean of excellence. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ihu tan jaal jin jaliai naam visaariaa ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, burn this body; this burnt body has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਿਵੰਧੈ ਤਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paudee jaai paraal pichhai hath na a(n)baRai tit niva(n)dhai taal ||1||
lines.translation: The dirt is piling up, and in the world hereafter, your hand shall not be able to reach down into this stagnant pond to clean it out. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਮ ਫਿਟਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man ke ka(n)m phitiaa ganat na aavahee ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, wicked are the uncountable actions of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀ ਲਹਾ ਸਹੰਮ ਜਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਾ ਧਕਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kitee lahaa saha(n)m jaa bakhase taa dhakaa nahee ||2||
lines.translation: They bring terrible and painful retributions, but if the Lord forgives me, then I will be spared this punishment. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa amar chalaaion kar sach phuramaan ||
lines.translation: True is the Command He sends forth, and True are the Orders He issues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa nihachal rav rahiaa so purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: Forever unmoving and unchanging, permeating and pervading everywhere, He is the All-knowing Primal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee seveeai sach sabad neesaan ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, serve Him, through the True Insignia of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa thaat banaaiaa ra(n)g guramat maan ||
lines.translation: That which He makes is perfect; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar alakh hai guramukh har jaan ||11||
lines.translation: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and unseen; as Gurmukh, know the Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਦਰਾ ਮਾਲ ਕਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਆਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak badaraa maal kaa bheetar dhariaa aan ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the bags of coins are brought in

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khote khare parakheean saahib kai deebaan ||1||
lines.translation: and placed in the Court of our Lord and Master, and there, the genuine and the counterfeit are separated. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਣ ਚਲੇ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਤਨਿ ਚੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naavan chale teerathee man khotai tan chor ||
lines.translation: They go and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but their minds are still evil, and their bodies are thieves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਭਾਉ ਲਥੀ ਨਾਤਿਆ ਦੁਇ ਭਾ ਚੜੀਅਸੁ ਹੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik bhaau lathee naatiaa dui bhaa chaReeas hor ||
lines.translation: Some of their filth is washed off by these baths, but they only accumulate twice as much.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੂਮੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar dhotee toomaRee a(n)dar vis nikor ||
lines.translation: Like a gourd, they may be washed off on the outside, but on the inside, they are still filled with poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ਅਣਨਾਤਿਆ ਚੋਰ ਸਿ ਚੋਰਾ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saadh bhale ananaatiaa chor s choraa chor ||2||
lines.translation: The holy man is blessed, even without such bathing, while a thief is a thief, no matter how much he bathes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hukam chalaaidaa jag dha(n)dhai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself issues His Commands, and links the people of the world to their tasks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aape hee aap laaian gur te sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself joins some to Himself, and through the Guru, they find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dah dis ihu man dhaavadaa gur thaak rahaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The mind runs around in the ten directions; the Guru holds it still.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naavai no sabh lochadee guramatee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Everyone longs for the Name, but it is only found through the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhur likhiaa met na sakeeai jo har likh paaiaa ||12||
lines.translation: Your pre-ordained destiny, written by the Lord in the very beginning, cannot be erased. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਦੀਵੇ ਚਉਦਹ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dui deeve chaudah hatanaale ||
lines.translation: The two lamps light the fourteen markets.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jete jee tete vanajaare ||
lines.translation: There are just as many traders as there are living beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੑੇ ਹਟ ਹੋਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: khulhe hat hoaa vaapaar ||
lines.translation: The shops are open, and trading is going on;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo pahuchai so chalanahaar ||
lines.translation: whoever comes there, is bound to depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਦਲਾਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam dalaal paae neesaan ||
lines.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is the broker, who gives his sign of approval.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam laahaa paravaan ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who earn the profit of the Naam are accepted and approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar aae vajee vaadhaaee ||
lines.translation: And when they return home, they are greeted with cheers;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach naam kee milee vadiaaee ||1||
lines.translation: they obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਕਾਲੀਆ ਸੁਪੇਦਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: raatee hovan kaaleeaa supedaa se va(n)n ||
lines.translation: Even when the night is dark, whatever is white retains its white color.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਹੁ ਬਗਾ ਤਪੈ ਘਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ਕਾਲੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: dihu bagaa tapai ghanaa kaaliaa kaale va(n)n ||
lines.translation: And even when the light of day is dazzlingly bright, whatever is black retains its black color.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe akalee baahare moorakh a(n)dh giaan ||
lines.translation: The blind fools have no wisdom at all; their understanding is blind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree baahare kabahi na paavahi maan ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Lord's Grace, they will never receive honor. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kot rachaaiaa har sachai aape ||
lines.translation: The True Lord Himself created the body-fortress.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik doojai bhaai khuaaian haumai vich viaape ||
lines.translation: Some are ruined through the love of duality, engrossed in egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਸਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu maanas janam dula(n)bh saa manamukh sa(n)taape ||
lines.translation: This human body is so difficult to obtain; the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee jis satigur thaape ||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand; he is blessed by the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag khel rachaaion sabh varatai aape ||13||
lines.translation: He created the entire world for His play; He is pervading amongst all. ||13||
